title: The Lifetime of the Earth
subtitle: 4,570,000,000 years, five million to a page

page._note: Untrimmed page = half of a US Letter sheet folded (5.5 x 8.5 in). Outside margin includes the foredge trim. Tune after printed tests.

foredge._note: Bands start at the untrimmed outer edge and run inward band_width_mm; trim_mm is cut off by the plough, leaving (band_width - trim) visible on the page.
